summary: Two readers read the map's Chinese through as Chinese; one reviewer reads the tool's code. Read only.
logs: zh boxes/arrows: 45 edits; zh page/paths: 45 edits; code: 17 findings

edits.where: box b3.inside (自己评自己), says_zh, first sentence
edits.old: 规则偏向的一方，既定规则，也定怎么评这条规则。
edits.new: 规则由它偏向的一方来定，怎么评这条规则，也由这一方来定。
edits.why: “既定规则” is a fixed word (established rules); the eye takes it as a noun and the sentence falls apart. This is the central box of the first path.

edits.where: arrow a2.ended → a2.supplied (尽了 → 够用), tag_zh
edits.old: 需要放松了，或者外面有补给
edits.new: 需要变小了，或者外面有补给
edits.why: “需要放松了” reads as 'needs to relax' (需要 as a verb). Elsewhere the same thing is 需要小了 / 需要变小了.

edits.where: arrow a2.ended → a2.supplied, zh
edits.old: 只有还在延续的才给得出、延续又要每样需要都满足的地方：一群里一旦哪个都不够用，只要需要不放松、群外也没有往它们要用的东西里补，就再没有哪个够用。
edits.new: 要是只有还在延续的才给得出，延续又要每样需要都满足：一群里一旦哪个都不够用，只要没有哪样需要变小、群外也没有往它们要用的东西里补，就再没有哪个够用。
edits.why: “……的地方：” is the English 'Where …' carried over as a 30-character modifier; “需要不放松” has the same misreading as the tag. Both conditions kept.

edits.where: arrow e2.good | e2.swing (又补回来了 | 来回摆，停不住), zh
edits.old: 回推越过那个点，恰在它超过缺口的时候。按固定步子、读数又来得晚的纠正：恰在带宽容得下延迟期间推出去的量时，才停在带内；否则有的起点会在带的两头之外来回摆，没有止境。
edits.new: 推回越不越过那个点，只看它超不超过缺口。按固定步子推、读数又来得晚的纠正：它守的范围容得下延迟期间推出去的量，才停在范围之内；容不下，就有从下方起步的在范围两头之外来回摆，没有止境。
edits.why: “带宽容得下” parses as 带宽 (bandwidth) or 宽容 (tolerance); bare “带” is not a Chinese word for a range (P98 already says 范围). “回推” is 推回 in the box. The dropped 'a start below' is restored. Both iffs kept.

edits.where: arrow b2.uncounted → b2.counted (用掉的不在账上 → 代价算进去了), zh
edits.old: 规则若在自己的标准达到之后把原先漏掉的那一样也算上，最好的结果守得住需要，恰在有办法既达标又守住的时候；规则若奖励守住，则在奖励超过守住所放弃的时候。
edits.new: 规则若在自己的标准达到之后，把原先漏掉的那一样也算上：最好的结果守不守得住需要，只看有没有一种办法既达标又守住。规则若是奖励守住：奖励超过为守住而放弃的，最好的结果就守得住。
edits.why: “守住所放弃的” contains 住所 and is read wrongly; the second half has no predicate (“则在……的时候” of what?). First half stays an iff, second stays a sufficient 'where'.

edits.where: box c1.same (从这儿看都一样), eg_zh
edits.old: 比如只在油箱见底时才亮的油灯：半箱和快没了，看起来一样。
edits.new: 比如只在油箱见底时才亮的油量警示灯：半箱和快没了，看起来一样。
edits.why: 油灯 is an oil lamp, not a fuel warning light.

edits.where: stay at e2.rest (不再变了), zh
edits.old: 过程一旦到了它的律不再改变的状态，此后每一步都停在那里：律固定时，里面没有什么能再推动它。
edits.new: 过程一旦到了一个它的规律不会再去改动的状态，此后每一步都停在那里：规律固定时，里面没有什么能再推动它。
edits.why: “它的律不再改变的状态” reads as 'the state in which its law stops changing'; the English is a state the law leaves as it is. Bare 律 is not an ordinary word (规律 is used in P73).

edits.where: box b2.felt (及时传到了), says_zh
edits.old: 已经影响到了能左右规则的一方
edits.new: 已经影响到了定规则时算数的一方
edits.why: English: 'something whose judgment enters the rule'. “能左右规则” says they can sway it, which the next sentence and the arrow to 传到了，定局不改 deny. P26 already uses 定规则时算数的一方.

edits.where: arrow b2.uncounted → a2.supplied (用掉的不在账上 → 够用), zh
edits.old: 要是允许的结果只限于保住每一份需要的那些，其中还能多得，那么按规则最好的结果一份供给也不会断：它取走的，恰好是超出需要的富余。
edits.new: 要是只允许这样的结果：靠规则不算的那样东西的每一份需要都保得住；这些结果里又还能多得，那么按规则最好的结果，哪一份需要都不会断供：它取走的，恰好是超出这些需要的富余。
edits.why: The English condition is 'every need on the uncounted thing'; the Chinese says every need whatever. Also “只限于保住每一份需要的那些” is a hard modifier with a dangling 那些.

edits.where: box e2.round (转一圈又回来), says_zh, second sentence
edits.old: 路上每个环节收多少就传多少，转着走的东西每一圈都原样回来。
edits.new: 要是路上每个环节收多少就传多少，转着走的东西每一圈都原样回来。
edits.why: English has 'Where each link … passes on exactly what it gets'; the Chinese states it as a fact of the box. The condition must show.

edits.where: box a1.over (用得比补得快), says_zh, last sentence
edits.old: 这里用不着什么规则。
edits.new: 有没有规则，都可以这样。
edits.why: “用不着什么规则” reads as 'no rule is needed here' (a recommendation). English: no rule need be involved.

edits.where: box a1.new (总有新的), says_zh, second sentence
edits.old: 这要来的比去的多，还要原先不变的东西也跟着变。
edits.new: 要这样，来的得比去的多，原先固定不变的东西也得一直在变。
edits.why: “这要来的” is read as 'this that is about to come'. 'keep changing' was also thinned to 跟着变.

edits.where: arrow a1.over → a1.past (用得比补得快 → 回不了头了), zh, second sentence
edits.old: 回不了头的那一点，来的时候靠它延续的还够用。
edits.new: 回不了头的那一点到来的时候，靠它延续的还够用。
edits.why: The comma cuts subject from verb; “来的时候靠它延续的” is read as one phrase.

edits.where: arrow b0.together → b0.lost (各自不多，合起来超了 → 留着不如拿走), zh
edits.old: 补给这份存量的，自己也靠它延续；其余的光是它们自己，取的就一直比补的多。时间够长，存量就跌到那份需要以下，再也回不来，多出来的那一个取多取少都一样；事后再去看存量，它的取和它的留得分相同。
edits.new: 补给这份存量的，自己也靠它延续；其余的不算再添的那一个，取的就已经比补的多，而且这样持续得够久。那么存量就跌到补给它的那一方的需要以下，再也回不来，再添的那一个取多取少都一样；事后再去看存量，它取也好、留也好，得分都一样。
edits.why: “那份需要” has no antecedent (it is the renewer's need); “多出来的那一个” appears unannounced; “留得分相同” is segmented 留得/分 or 留/得分.

edits.where: arrow b1.held → b2.counted (自己撑住自己 → 代价算进去了), zh
edits.old: 其余的开始把损耗算进去，规则接连重定两次：规则就此转过去、定在另一边，恰好是在第二次重定时，合起来的判断仍然不利于它原先偏向的一方。是什么让它们开始算，没有定律说。
edits.new: 其余的开始把损耗算进去，规则接连重定两次：规则是不是就此转过去、定在另一边，只看第二次重定时，合起来的判断是不是仍然不利于它原先偏向的一方。是什么让它们开始算，没有定律说。
edits.why: “恰好是在第二次重定时，” is read as a time ('exactly at the second update'), and the if-and-only-if disappears. P28 already says it the clear way.

edits.where: arrow d0.line → a2.ended (全靠另一个撑着 → 尽了), zh, second sentence
edits.old: 尽顺着每一条这样的链往下传
edits.new: 这个“尽”顺着每一条这样的链往下传
edits.why: Sentence-initial bare 尽 is read as the adverb (尽量/尽都).

edits.where: box b0.pays (留下的还归自己), says_zh — the first sentence on the page
edits.old: 一个取用的留下多少，日后至少原样归它自己：没有别的先拿走，长得也比“以后”打的折扣快。这时最好的做法里，总有留下一些的。
edits.new: 取用的一方留下多少，日后至少原样归它自己：没有别的先拿走，它长得也快过“以后”要打的折扣。这时最好的做法里，总有留下一些的。
edits.why: “一个取用的” is not a noun phrase in Chinese (the page elsewhere says 取用的一方); “长得也比……折扣快” compares growing with a discount without saying so.

edits.where: box d1.round (有来有往), says_zh
edits.old: 各自都因为所等的给了才给，于是给就这么接下去。中断能过去、不传开，是在这样的地方：所等的里面少了这么几个它也照给，或者中断短过它肯等的步数；要是各自都得所等的上一步全给了才给，中断就往下传。
edits.new: 各自都是所等的给了才给，于是给就这么接下去。中断在两种情形下过得去、不传开：所等的里面断了几个，它少这几个也照给；或者中断比它肯等的步数短。要是各自都得所等的上一步全给了才给，中断就往下传。
edits.why: “是在这样的地方：” is 'where' calqued; “这么几个” points at nothing (it is 'as many as lapsed'); “因为……才” doubles the cause.

edits.where: box d1.gap (有一环没接上), says_zh
edits.old: 至少有一个不给了，别的还在给。这个缺口要么被带过去，要么等着它的跟着不给：顺着一串“等”传下去、到头就出去了，或者在一圈“等”里一直转，或者在中断补不回来的地方，传到顺着“等”够得着的每一个，从此都不给。
edits.new: 至少有一个不给了，别的还在给。这个缺口要么就这么过去了，要么等着它的也跟着不给：顺着一串“等”传下去，传到头就没了；或者在一圈“等”里一直转；或者，要是中断从来补不回，就传到顺着“等”够得着的每一个，从此都不给。
edits.why: “被带过去” does not say 'passed over'; “到头就出去了” is opaque; three alternatives run together with commas and another “……的地方”.

edits.where: box d3.several (各用各的), says_zh
edits.old: 不止一种做法在用，或者还没有哪一种，还没有都归到同一个上。
edits.new: 在用的做法不止一种，或者一种都还没有；总之还没有都归到同一个上。
edits.why: Two “还没有” in a row with different subjects; the reader cannot tell what the second one belongs to.

edits.where: box d0.ring (彼此都离不开), says_zh
edits.old: 哪一个做了什么，隔着几层，都够得着其余每一个的延续，也就绕回它自己。取和给一样算：这说的是相连，不是善意。按时间先后看，这种够得着可能到某一步就断了。
edits.new: 哪一个做了什么，隔着几层，都影响得到其余每一个能不能延续，也就绕回它自己。取和给一样算：这说的是相连，不是善意。按时间先后看，这种相连可能到某一步就断了。
edits.why: “够得着……的延续” and the noun “这种够得着” are 'reach' translated word for word.

edits.where: arrow d1.gap → d1.round (有一环没接上 → 有来有往), zh
edits.old: 各自都能少等几个、少的不比断掉的少时，下一步全都照给。各自只要所等的都给了就给、而一串串的“等”有个最长的长度时，过了那么多步全都照给。
edits.new: 所等的里面断掉几个，各自都少得起这么几个时，下一步全都照给。各自只要所等的都给了就给、而一串串的“等”长度有上限时，过了上限那么多步，全都照给。
edits.why: “少的不比断掉的少” is three 少 in a comparison nobody can unpick at reading speed; “那么多步” has no number to point to.

edits.where: arrow d0.ring | a1.past (彼此都离不开 | 回不了头了), zh
edits.old: 有限多份存量，哪一份剩得多了，各自得到的补给都不会更少，并且都在一个带内：其中一份走到尽，恰好是它起步时低于某个最低水平；别的存量站得越高，这个水平不会更高。
edits.new: 有限的几份存量，不管哪一份剩得多些，各自得到的补给都不会因此变少，水平又都不出一个范围：其中一份会不会走到尽，只看它起步时是不是低于某个最低水平；别的存量多些，这个最低水平不会更高。
edits.why: “都在一个带内” means nothing to a Chinese reader (P98 says 范围); “存量站得越高” is 'stand higher' calqued; “不会更少” needs its comparison.

edits.where: arrow e1.line → e1.ring (只往下传，不回来 → 做出去的又绕回自己), zh, first sentence
edits.old: 一条因果的链子在某一步合成圈，恰在这一步有个起作用的环节，它给出多少，要看它所给之处下游的某个存量。
edits.new: 一条因果的链子是不是在某一步合成环，只看这一步有没有一个起作用的环节，它给出多少，要看它给到的地方下游的某个存量。
edits.why: “恰在这一步有个……” reads as 'right at this step there is …'; the iff is lost. 环 is the word in this band (圈 is the lock's loop in band B). “所给之处” is bookish.

edits.where: arrow e2.norest → e2.rest (怎么都不算够 → 不再变了), zh
edits.old: 至多比上限多一步就停下
edits.new: 至多走“上限加一”步就停下
edits.why: Can be read as 'stops one step beyond the ceiling'. English: within (ceiling + 1) steps.

edits.where: stay at d0.ring (彼此都离不开), zh
edits.old: 没有哪条定律说它会一直在。按时间先后看，从某一步起断了，从以后每一步起也都断了；造出来的一对，从第一步起连着，从第二步起就不连了，另一对从每一步起都连着。
edits.new: 没有哪条定律说它会一直在。按时间先后看，从某一步算起已经不相连，从以后哪一步算起也都不相连；造出来的一对，从第一步算起相连，从第二步算起就不相连了，另一对从每一步算起都相连。
edits.why: “从某一步起断了，从以后每一步起也都断了” sounds like a tautology; the point is 'counted from that step'.

edits.where: stay at d0.line (全靠另一个撑着), zh
edits.old: 每个部分都在它才在的整体，恰好在每个部分都在的时候延续，用不着有什么新生出来。造出来的一条链里，有一环不被取用，它就不会被耗干，靠着它的也就保住了，尽管链头已经尽了。
edits.new: 要每个部分都在、自己才在的整体：每个部分都在，它就延续，少一个就不延续，用不着有什么新生出来。造出来的一条链里，有一环没有被取用，它就耗不干，靠着它的也就保住了，尽管链头已经尽了。
edits.why: “每个部分都在它才在的整体” has to be read twice to find where the modifier ends; two 被 in one clause. The same opening stands in the first 'more' under d0.line → a2.ended and wants the same fix.

edits.where: arrow b0.pays → a2.supplied (留下的还归自己 → 够用), zh
edits.old: 那份需要就在这几步之内重新供上
edits.new: 那份需要就在它长到那里的步数之内重新供上
edits.why: “这几步” points at steps that were never mentioned.

edits.where: stay at c1.old (还按老样子看), zh, first half
edits.old: 不重新去看，不管走什么样的步子，两段经历里的看法都一样，实情却还是不同
edits.new: 只要不重新去看，不管怎么做，实情不同的两段经历里，看法始终一样，实情也始终不同
edits.why: “两段经历” arrives with no introduction; “走什么样的步子” is 'course of acts' word for word.

edits.where: stay at c1.same (从这儿看都一样), zh, second half
edits.old: 在一样对待两种说法的试验里怎么找，它们的次序也不变。
edits.new: 只在对两种说法一样对待的试验里挑，怎么挑，这两种说法的先后次序也不变。
edits.why: “怎么找” has no object and “它们” could be the trials. The arrow below already says 挑试验 / 先后次序.

edits.where: stay at c1.checked (拿实际对过了), zh
edits.old: 单子上的一种说法，在实情始终不离开的一个范围里处处预料得和实情的回应一样，就永远不会被排除；对得上实际情形的报告，也不会把实际情形从认为可能的里面去掉。
edits.new: 单子上的一种说法，只要实情始终不出某个范围，它在这个范围里又处处料得和实情的回应一样，就永远不会被排除；报告对得上实际情形，就不会把实际情形从认为可能的里面去掉。
edits.why: One 30-character adverbial before the verb; split into the two conditions it holds.

edits.where: arrow c1.checked → c1.open (拿实际对过了 → 不合的一个个排除), zh, first clause
edits.old: 预料到会变，凡是这个变化能从某个还认为可能的状态通向的状态，就都算作可能，不管先前排除过没有
edits.new: 预料到会变：从任何一个还认为可能的状态出发，这个变化通得到的状态就都算作可能，不管先前排除过没有
edits.why: “凡是……能从……的状态通向的状态” is a relative clause nested in the English order.

edits.where: arrow d2.handed → a2.ended (换了一茬，格局还在 → 尽了), more[1].zh
edits.old: 一条线要尽，最后那一步必定离开了它的“同”里能自己接续下去的那一部分；守着这一部分的步子，不会是最后一步。不管把哪一种“同”看作接续，都是这样。
edits.new: 一条传承要尽，最后那一步必定离开了它算作“还是同一个”所凭的东西里，能自己接续下去的那一部分；守住这一部分的步子，不会是最后一步。不管把哪一种“同一个”算作延续，都是这样。
edits.why: “它的“同”” is our own coinage and tells a new reader nothing; “一条线” is 传承 everywhere else.

edits.where: arrow a1.past → a2.else (回不了头了 → 还在，但已不是原样), zh
edits.old: 凡延续都要每一步需要得到满足的地方：一样东西失去了又不再回来，之后还在延续的，不会仍以原先那么大的需要靠着它；要么需要小了，要么不再靠它。
edits.new: 要是延续得每一步每样需要都满足：一样东西失去了又不再回来，之后还在延续的，对它的需要不会还像原先那么大；要么小了，要么不再靠它。
edits.why: “……的地方：” for 'Where …'; “以原先那么大的需要靠着它” is 'at as great a need' word for word.

zh_boxes.read_through: Read in order, /Users/ren/theories/tmp/r7/sheet/v2/out/PLACES.zh.md starts well and gets harder as it goes down. The names of bands, rows and boxes are the best Chinese on the page (留着不如拿走, 回不了头了, 只走熟路, 都等对方先给, 缺一样，卡住了, 怎么都不算够); the examples are short and land at once; bands A and B mostly read as someone talking, and no name, tag or arrow sentence uses 人, 谁 or 大家. What tires is the arrows' if-and-only-if: “恰好是在这样的时候：” comes 15 times and “恰在……的时候／地方” 11 more, and in several the reader takes 恰在 as a time or place and loses the condition (b1.held → b2.counted, e1.line → e1.ring); the three arrows that say “……，只看一条：……” read far better and I rewrote the worst ones that way. The second tiring habit is English "Where …" turned into “……的地方：” after a thirty-character modifier (twelve times), and the third is the “另外” items under an arrow, which in bands C and D outweigh the arrow itself (d1.gap → d1.round carries four, d2.handed → a2.ended three) and are where most of the dense sentences sit. What is still not Chinese: bare 律 for a system's law, 带／带内／带宽 for a range, “它的“同””, 尽 standing as a sentence subject, 够得着 used as a noun, “不更少／不更小／不更弱”, “越来越后的步子上”, 过程 counted with 条 (每条过程, 两条过程), and 所等的 everywhere in row d1. A handful are real traps rather than stiffness: 既定规则, 需要放松了, 带宽容得下, 守住所放弃的, 这要来的, 留得分, and 油灯 for a fuel light. Page-level things outside the data (/Users/ren/theories/tmp/r7/sheet/v2/md_views.py): every box paragraph on the Chinese page opens with its English name as if it were the first sentence ("What it spares comes back to it. 一个取用的…"), the bold tags and labels end in a Latin full stop and the kind notes use a Latin semicolon ("留下一份…一份.", "已证明; 目前只有一位读者看过", "放在这里的检验:"), the folded 图谱里放在这里的动态 lists are English only, and “这项工作想到达的方框之一” is first read 想到／达 (想要到达 avoids it). Three places where the Chinese and English differ in content and I left the Chinese alone for the coordinator to settle: b0.together → a1.within has a closing sentence the English lacks (“实际的分法是不是这样，定律没有说。”); b2.uncounted → b3.gone adds “没有一般的定律”; e1.ring | e1.line says the link 取读数 from a standing level where the English says "fed" (the Lean docstring says "reading the level", so the English may be the one to check). Smaller things I did not spend edits on: b1.outside's example “会考这个试的” (会考 is itself a noun), c1.checked → c1.old 年限 for an age bound (期限), c1.old → c1.checked “手里够改的本钱” (missing 有) and “报告如实反应时” (adds 如实), d1.wait → d1.round “到某一步起” (从某一步起), d2.stalled's stay “总账这时还在界内”, b3.list “衡量的对象是……名单” (the arrow says 按……名单来量), and d1.gap → d1.wait which opens with another “……才给的地方：”.
zh_boxes.terms:
Forms to keep, with where the other form stands (passages.json unless marked).
1. Built example: keep 造出来的（例子／一例／一对）, which is also the kind label. 构造的例子／一个构造的过程／构造出来的例子／构造的两方例子 stand 22 times, nearly all in band C and its stays.
2. A system's own law: keep 规律 (as in c1.open → c1.checked). Bare 律 stands in the stays at d3.several, e1.line, e2.rest, in e2.grow → e2.round and in the second 'more' of d3.several → d3.one. 定律 only for the map's proved laws.
3. Band of levels: keep 范围 (d0.ring → e2.rest; e1.ring → e2.round 'more'). 带／带内／带宽 stand in e2.good | e2.swing, d0.ring | a1.past and the third 'more' of d2.handed → a2.ended (一条在带内的规则).
4. Ring of effects in band E: keep 环. 圈 stands in e1.line → e1.ring (合成圈) and the 'more' of e1.ring | e1.line (合不成圈, 圈只在……). Keep 圈 for the lock's loop in band B and for 一圈“等”.
5. Push back: keep 推回 (box e2.good, e2.good → e2.rest, stay e2.swing). 回推 stands in e2.good | e2.swing and the stay at e2.good (and in paths.json).
6. Correction: keep 纠正. 修正 stands in d2.stalled → a2.supplied, d2.stalled → d2.handed and a 'more' of d2.handed | d2.stalled; 改正 in the tag of c1.nomeans = d2.stalled.
7. Holder of a taught rule: keep 持守的; 持有的 stands in d2.handed → a2.ended. Quota: keep 名额; 额度 in the same sentence.
8. Lapse in giving: keep 中断; 出了差错 in d1.round → d1.wait.
9. Unit of stock: keep 一份; 一个单位 in d2.stalled → a2.supplied and a 'more' of d2.handed | d2.stalled. Link: keep 环节; 联系 in d2.stalled → a2.supplied.
10. A reading (not proved): keep 解读 (the kind label); “只是一种读法” in b3.gone → b2.felt. Leave 读法 for how a thing reads a stock (c1.same → c1.open 'more').
11. Lock: keep 定局／定住; 锁 in sheet.json b3.inside unlike_zh (“不是闭合的锁”).
12. A need loosens: keep 需要变小／小了; 需要放松 in a2.ended → a2.supplied (tag and sentence).
13. What sets the rule: keep 定规则的一方／定规则时算数的一方. “定规则的那些” in b2.uncounted → a1.past and b3.rest | b2.felt (各方 reads better); “能左右规则的一方” in sheet.json b2.felt.
14. Read a loss in time: keep 读到 (box names, paths); 发觉 in b2.uncounted → a1.past.
15. Close a difference: 合上 is natural for 缺口 only; for 差别 use 消掉 (e1.ring → e2.grow “一圈就合上”, e1.ring → e2.round “哪一圈都不合上”, e2.round → e2.good).
16. Lineage: keep 传承; “一条线” in the second 'more' of d2.handed → a2.ended.
17. Update of the rule: keep 重定. 改 is also 改规则 (shaping), so the tag “规则开始照自己的结果改” (b1.outside → b1.swing) and the box name 跟着结果改，还没定住 can be taken for shaping.
18. Weight of a set of courses: keep 权重／所占份额; 分量 and “凭带权的机会” in the first 'more' of d3.several → d3.one (b1.held → d3.one says 按权重随机).
19. Course or run: 过程 is used throughout, but with 条 (每条过程, 两条过程, 一条过程, 10 times) it is not how Chinese counts a 过程; 每一个过程, or 走法 where a choice of course is meant.
20. "No less / no smaller": 不更少／不更小／不更弱 (b1.swing → b1.held, b1.held → b2.uncounted) against 不减 on the first path of THE-MAP.zh.md; keep 不减 or 不会因此变少.
21. What it waits on: 所等的 (boxes and arrows of row d1) against 它等的 (one 'more' of d1.gap → d1.round); either, but one.
22. The thing a view is of: band and boxes say 实情; the box name says 拿实际对过了 and the arrows 实际情形. Keep 实情 for the thing, 实际情形 for its actual state.

zh_paths.read_through: A reader coming cold gets the frame at once: 每一行问一件事／每个方框是一种可能的回答 is plain; the box names are spoken Chinese (留着不如拿走、都等对方先给、看出来了，没本钱改); the examples are the best lines on the pages (键盘布局、你先签，我就签、淋浴调水温); the stock path and the tests' one-line summaries (line_zh) can be read aloud. What stops him comes before the steps: the first paragraph asks him to hold 规则不算的东西、读得到损耗的、过程自己的、过程之外给定的 and 重定 before any of them has been shown. Then the first path runs eighteen steps whose actors are almost all headless 的 phrases (定规则的那些、算这笔损耗的、读得到损耗的、其余的、承载它的), the price of keeping 人 out, so he keeps asking "the what?"; 各方／一方, already in the text, does that job without naming a person. Three things tire. First, conditions are stacked before a colon with no 要是 or 只要, so several read as facts (lock 15, view 8, giving 6). Second, 恰好是在…的时候 comes seven times in the paths, and 画出的定律／这里没有定律说 nine times between them. Third, each 这条路显出来的 block retells its path as a ledger of step numbers and is nearly as long as the path. What is still not Chinese: 改 meaning both "update" and "shape" in the first path; 读 for what is not text (规则来得及读到、评委读起来不是…读者池); 水平 for a level in the last path; "0 of 60" as 60 季里 0 季留住; 关于留在这里，已经知道的; 这让…停在哪里; and, from the tool's frames, the English word At in every pin line and half-width . : ; ( ) glued to Chinese labels (这条路显出来的. ／ 第一条路: ／ (15 步).). Of the three tests read in full, the lake and the fish stocks read well apart from the points listed; the judge leans on 读者池. One thing for whoever applies this: the rendered pages in out/ are older than the module (the first page there lists pins where the module now prints line_zh), so the line_zh sentences were read from laid.json, not from a page. All 45 old strings were checked against the files: each is a whole field value or occurs exactly once.

findings.summary: validate() accepts a laid test with no pins, but build() then computes t['bands'] from max(ys)/min(ys). If the test also has no 'used' and no 'view', ys is empty and build raises ValueError. A test with no 'pins' key raises KeyError in validate itself.
findings.failure_scenario: A laid.json test {'id': 'x', ..., 'pins': [], 'used': []} with no view passes validate(), and then build() raises 'ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence' at line 457.
findings.fix: In validate: if not t.get('pins'): E.append('test %s: no pins' % t['id']); continue. Likewise require a 'test' key (line 166 uses t['test']).

findings.summary: The template treats any present pth.bands as a crop, and [] is truthy in JS: Math.max(...[]) gives -Infinity, so the viewBox becomes '0 0 W -Infinity'. chart() treats crop=[] as the whole map, so the two views disagree. validate() does not require a path's bands to be non-empty.
findings.failure_scenario: paths.json path with "bands": []: path-<id>.svg shows the whole map, while the interactive page sets an invalid viewBox and the chart vanishes when that path is chosen.
findings.fix: In validate: if not path.get('bands'): E.append('path %s: no bands' % path['id']). In the template, test pth && pth.bands && pth.bands.length on lines 256, 257 and 260.

findings.summary: Only far arrows are cut and labelled at the crop edge. A lit near, ell or arc arrow, a 'box:'/'stay:' box, or a known/eg box outside the path's declared bands is drawn running off the cropped picture with no label. validate() never checks that a path's boxes lie in its bands.
findings.failure_scenario: A path with bands ['A'] whose step stands on a 'near' passage from the last row of band A to the first row of band B: rows in adjacent bands are adjacent in ri, so it is classed 'near'. The curve runs off the bottom of path-<id>.svg and its to-box is invisible, with no '→' label. The same happens in the interactive page (map_sheet.html:267 also cuts only p.far).
findings.fix: In validate, for each path: every box in cset must lie in a band of path['bands'], unless it is reached only as the far end of a far passage. Otherwise report 'path X: box Y is outside its bands'.

findings.summary: The JSON injected into <script> escapes only '</'. A data string containing '<!--' followed by '<script' puts the HTML tokenizer into the script-data double-escaped state. The template's own </script> then does not close the script, and the rest of the page is swallowed.
findings.failure_scenario: Any sentence in sheet/passages/paths/laid.json containing '<!-- <script' (e.g. quoting markup): the page's script never ends, and the panel and about section are not rendered.
findings.fix: .replace('<', '\\u003c') on the json.dumps output, instead of .replace('</', '<\\/'). Adjust the test at test_map_sheet.py:275, which un-escapes '<\\/'.

findings.summary: Box ids, band ids and path/test ids from the data go into attributes unescaped: data-id and class 'band-%s' in chart() (lines 363, 388, 399), and data-cond/data-case/data-path in the template (map_sheet.html:276, 277, 295, 322, 335, 342, 345, 387, 388). validate() does not restrict the id format.
findings.failure_scenario: A box id with a double quote or a space (e.g. 'b1 "x') breaks the SVG markup and the template's attribute strings. An id with '<' breaks the static SVG's XML.
findings.fix: In validate, require every box, row, band, path and test id to match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ (or esc() each id at every place it is written).
